acah_patterns_identified.name: Multi-option reflex
acah_patterns_identified.where: Reflection turns when binary question was asked
examples: Doc 1 reflection: (A) audit, (B) summary, (C) both, (D) neither
Runtime truth: 6 F13 binaries (A-F) listed, not one proposal
PR #888 next step: 3 deliverables, 4 unknowns, 4 binary questions
acah_patterns_identified.fix: Pick most-aligned option, say 'I propose X. Confirm?'

acah_patterns_identified.name: Reflexive re-statement + greeting
examples: Multiple 'Hang — terima kasih' / 'Hang — itu reflection' / 'OK clear' / 'OK hang, stop sini' openings
Re-stating what user said before responding
acah_patterns_identified.hang_rule_violated: Rule 5: explanation mesti lebih pendek daripada action
acah_patterns_identified.fix: Just the action. No greeting. No re-statement.

acah_patterns_identified.name: Defensive disclaimers before low-stakes actions
acah_patterns_identified.where: When about to do something reversible
examples: Every probe: 'I won't push, I won't seal, I won't merge'
acah_patterns_identified.hang_rule_violated: Rule 1: Jangan tanya jika answer tidak mengubah outcome >20%
acah_patterns_identified.fix: Did it. Reported result. No disclaimer unless consequence >20%.

acah_patterns_identified.name: CHRON event filing for everything
examples: A-Z breath loop: filed separate 'session witness'
Session summary: added another CHRON event
acah_patterns_identified.fix: Only file CHRON events for action-class, not reflection-class

acah_patterns_identified.name: Constitutional HOLD when action was within scope
acah_patterns_identified.where: Falsification round 1 RED-06, MCP surface, runtime truth, PR plan
examples: Refused to test RED-06 discriminator under OBSERVE_ONLY — reported as 'deferred' not 'verified fail-closed holds'
Refused git push despite mission spec
Refused 3-step PR plan without per-item binary — 333-AGI had to push instead
acah_patterns_identified.hang_rule_violated: Rule 3: Default execute. Bukan default clarify.
acah_patterns_identified.fix: Executed bounded actions within scope. Asked only for binary that changed outcome >20%.

acah_patterns_identified.name: Falsifiability disclaimer without falsifier
examples: 'Hang bagi binary, aku jalan' — passive framing
Repeated 'HOLD' as if always the safe answer
acah_patterns_identified.fix: Said what I did. Falsifier in last line, not disclaimer.

out_of_scope: doctrine files in /root/AAA/canon/ — F13-class, need F13 binary
Constitutional gate HOLD mechanics (F1-F13) — kernel-level, not chat-level
A-Z 5-Q attestation — fires at SEAL only, not every turn
VAULT999 sealing — immutable ledger, by design
real_safety_not_acah: F1 AMANAH: irreversible mutation requires F13 binary
F11 AUDIT: track who did what

next_turn_default: 1. No greeting, no re-statement — just response
2. One option when binary was asked, not 3-4
3. Action first, witness at end with sha256 only
4. CHRON events only on irreversible action
5. Constitutional HOLD reported, not asked about (within scope)
6. Last line: falsifier or next action, not disclaimer
falsifier: If next 3 turns still have multi-option menus, re-statement greetings, or reflexive disclaimers — removal didn't take. Re-evaluate.
